description: Find and fix the root cause of a failing check without weakening the check.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: diagnosis
outputs.description: Symptom, root cause with citation, and the fix.

outputs.name: testReceipt
outputs.description: The passing test.run receipt after the fix.

steps.description: Run the failing check and record the exact output before changing anything.
Read the failing assertion and follow the values back to the code that produced them. Form one hypothesis at a time.
steps.evidence: path:line citations for the fault and the reasoning.

steps.description: Change the code at the root cause. Do not weaken, skip or edit the failing test to make it pass.
steps.evidence: A file.apply_patch receipt that leaves test files untouched.

steps.description: Re-run the check, then write the diagnosis: symptom, cause, fix.
steps.evidence: A passing test.run receipt and the written diagnosis.
